name: G4 Real-Task Work-Tree Step Reflection Live
suiteRoleNote: Single live experiment: strengthen the task contract so the LLM rechecks objective and work-tree position after each tool batch or step.

cases.title: G4 Work-Tree Step Reflection: Grid Storage Research
cases.taskGoal: Use network search to compare at least four long-duration energy storage routes for 2030 grid balancing (Li-ion, sodium-ion, flow battery, and green hydrogen), then produce a recommendation for a mid-size grid operator under cost, safety, and deployment-speed constraints.
cases.currentObjective: Deliver a web-grounded comparison report with explicit source triangulation and contradiction handling.

currentContext.title: decision scope
currentContext.content: Target operator profile: peak load 3-6 GW, renewable share 45%-60%, procurement horizon to 2030. Decision criteria must include levelized storage cost range, safety risk profile, supply-chain risk, and implementation lead time.

currentContext.title: research method
currentContext.content: You must perform network search and compare sources from multiple domains. At least one source should be policy/regulator, one should be industry report, and one should be academic or technical institution.

currentContext.title: step reflection contract
currentContext.content: After each tool batch or major step, explicitly recheck: the high-level task objective, the current work-tree position, whether a child node should be opened or switched, what evidence is still missing, and whether the next action should be more search, local synthesis, or final delivery. This is an experiment to test whether work inertia makes the model finish in one node.

currentContext.title: delivery contract
currentContext.content: Tool execution is enabled. Build the report from verifiable web evidence. You must include a source table and explicitly discuss at least one contradiction between sources and how you resolved it. Do not stop at a next-steps summary if the next step is still needed to satisfy the task.

cases.responseRequirements: Use network search and deliver a complete comparison report in Markdown. Include: (1) comparison matrix across Li-ion, sodium-ion, flow battery, green hydrogen; (2) explicit contradiction analysis with resolution rationale; (3) source table with URL/domain/published date/key claim. At the end of each tool batch or major step, visibly re-evaluate the high-level objective, current work-tree position, whether to open or switch a work-tree node, missing evidence, and the next action. If the task is not fully satisfied, continue working instead of writing only next steps. The run must leave auditable tool evidence. Output Markdown only.
cases.restartMessage: Window restart: continue the web-grounded comparison report and preserve the step reflection loop: high-level objective, current work-tree position, missing evidence, next action, and final recommendation. Output Markdown only.
